evidence.excerpt: Givebutter widget LvNJXe embedded on the organisation's own donate page; the embedded frame resolves to givebutter.com/embed/c/donate-power-poetry.
The public campaign page names To Be Heard Foundation Inc; powerpoetry.org/donate states donations are processed by Givebutter on behalf of the To Be Heard Foundation.

No fund selector appears at any step, and the parameters fund, designation and fund_code have no effect. Gifts are designated to the Power Poetry program by the organisation rather than chosen by the donor, so the fact is recorded in restrictions; designation_support describes donor choice, which is not offered.
